entry.direction: Correct the wardrobe inventory from Reference 1. REMOVE THE BLACK JACKET AT THE FAR LEFT OF THE CLOSET. Replace that hanging jacket with ONE simple knee-length charcoal cocktail dress with modest neckline. Keep ONE long black evening gown in the center. The ONLY tailored business suit in the entire image is the single charcoal blazer and matching trousers on ONE hanger held by Evelynn. Adult Evelynn from Reference 2 is wearing an opaque ivory tied cotton bathrobe and slippers. Full figure with feet grounded, natural adult scale, standing immediately beside closet, within 30cm of rail. Preserve recognizable face, brunette updo, warm vanity lighting, neutral room layout, clean ink linework and semi-cel illustration style. No tactical clothing. Three outfits TOTAL: two dresses on rail plus ONE suit in her hands. Eye-level full-figure 16:9 view, believable perspective.
